pages.text: The Cracking Unit processes Heavy Oil in a formed 3×3×5 casing. It requires external heat and supports catalytic cracking and hydrocracking. Its current Horizon alpha implements both source recipes and four fluid output tanks. Use the Wrench on the top face to switch modes; use a side face to set its front.

# Catalytic mode
Catalytic cracking consumes 100 mB Heavy Oil per batch at 480°C, takes 20 ticks, and uses 30 HU/t. It yields 40 mB Naphtha, 40 mB Diesel, 55 mB Refinery Gas, and 10 mB Light Oil. Insert a Cracking Catalyst in the catalyst slot; one catalyst supports 50 batches. Feed heat through a Thermal Conduit.

# Hydrocracking mode
Hydrocracking consumes 100 mB Heavy Oil and 30 mB Hydrogen per batch at 520°C, takes 20 ticks, and uses 36 HU/t. It yields 10 mB Naphtha, 50 mB Diesel, 30 mB Kerosene, and 10 mB Light Oil. It does not require a catalyst. This alpha exposes fixed-capacity tanks and does not implement the source mod’s automatic product routing or detailed port modes.
